unknowns.detail: The public GitHub CSV content was not available through fetch_file (empty content); no source rows or run artifact were inspected; candidate count and date coverage cannot be established.
r25-uniswap-factory-csv.py checks global earliest/latest timestamps, but not block continuity or whether all PairCreated logs were included for each block.
The retrospective CSV does not establish contemporaneous availability or independent Ethereum ledger confirmation.
Current quote filter selects exactly one of WETH, USDC, USDT; it excludes pools with both or neither quote tokens. This is a rule-based subset, not all Ethereum launches.

Pool records are keyed by tx+pair, candidate_id by token address hash. Multiple quote pools for the same token are distinct pool records but one token candidate; verify pool-level and token-level counts separately.

The workflow's diagnostic startswith('2023-03'...) on Unix epoch timestamp strings; this produces misleading zero monthly counts even when 2023 rows exist. The parser itself converts epoch seconds correctly.

source_audit.proposed_next_task: Obtain R25 workflow artifact or original CSV bytes; audit timestamp coverage using UTC conversion, block continuity against Ethereum PairCreated logs, deduplicate token and pool identities and include unsuccessful launches before any as-of candidate reviews.

findings.detail: Workflow month counter compares epoch-second timestamps to ISO prefixes; fix report before using it as coverage evidence.
The parser does not independently validate missing blocks or complete factory log coverage.
